# Commands Build/Run checkout, cache provenance, and freshness status

`Build: unknown` occurs when `getConsoleBuildStatus()` cannot find `obj-tb-tools/build-status.json`. Builds before the freshness tracker cannot have populated it: automatic worktree builds and selected-checkout freshness are separate records. Add migration/fallback only after validating recent artifact provenance. [Task 4]

Scope: console.
